verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents its own background automations. Monitored SQL rules run on a set interval and fire Slack or HTTP webhook destinations. Refreshable materialized views recompute on their own, and large SQL operations can run as background batches of retryable tasks. These are narrow, alerting- and data-pipeline-scoped mechanisms rather than a general automation or agent-scheduling facility. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduled jobs/workflows, autonomous agent-triggered or agent-run automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
